payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the proposed multimodal NER (MNER) model learns from both text and images, utilizing visual context to enhance entity recognition.

claims.text: The MNER model incorporates both image and text modalities for named entity recognition, demonstrating effective learning from both sources.
The modality attention module in the MNER model selectively amplifies relevant visual contexts while integrating textual information, indicating a learning process from both modalities.
